title: Remove the plane-bus call wrappers, untrusted-content marking and bounded reads from core
goal: Vision: V-9. CEO direction 2026-11-18: core under 25,000 lines; move the bus wrappers and the two small modules. Core keeps the plane bus (topics, PlaneBus, PlaneHandler, shared DTO and helpers) and the two wrappers it calls itself (tools::execute_tool for GMCP dispatch, daemon::harness for the harness). The other typed call wrappers, untrusted_content and bounded_io have no caller in core; once Susi Commercial Apps owns them with their tests (T-CLAUDEBUS-1), delete core's copies and tests and lower COMPLETE_SOCKET_CEILING.

reuse.searched: Core's susi-core plane_bus, untrusted_content and bounded_io, and the susi-gmcp, susi-harness and susi-daemon re-exports; Susi Commercial Apps' agent-runtime. Delete-only: no new code and no dependency.
